description: This file defines a wizard interface for processing point-of-sale payments in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including functions for retrieving journals, initializing payment data, adding payments, validation, and invoice creation.

classes.name: pos_payment
classes.description: Wizard interface class managing POS payment process with multiple states

methods.name: _get_journal
methods.description: Retrieves available cash journals for POS payment

methods.name: _pre_init
methods.description: Prepares initial data for payment form, including amount, journal, and date

methods.name: _add_pay
methods.description: Adds a payment to the POS order

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Determines next action based on order state

methods.name: _test_no_line
methods.description: Checks if order has lines before proceeding

methods.name: create_invoice
methods.description: Creates invoice for the order if not already invoiced
